name: MAC Cross Country Championships
headline: MAC Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Toledo swept the team titles. The men scored 21 points to beat Miami (Ohio) (66) and UMass Amherst (98), with Toledo's Patrick Kiprop winning the 8K in 23:20.9. The Rocket women scored 25 to UMass Amherst's 97 and Bowling Green's 101, and Akron's Mercy Jebitok won the 6K in 19:19.9.
